# vaultwarden_users (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all users of the Vaultwarden server, including invited users.

Requires `admin_token` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vaultwarden_users" "all" {}

# Users with an account but without two-step login
output "users_without_two_factor" {
  value = [for user in data.vaultwarden_users.all.users : user.email if !user.invited && !user.two_factor_enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users of the server, sorted by email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the user was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC
- `email` (String) The email of the user
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user has verified their email. Always `true` when the server has no SMTP configured
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled. A disabled user cannot log in
- `id` (String) The ID of the user
- `invited` (Boolean) Whether the user was invited and has not created an account (set a master password) yet
- `last_active` (String) When the user was last active, as Vaultwarden formats it for display: `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss` and a time zone abbreviation, in the server's time zone (the `TZ` environment variable). `null` when the user has never logged in
- `name` (String) The name of the user, `null` when empty. Vaultwarden sets the name of an invited user to their email
- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations the user is a confirmed member of, sorted by name. Organizations the user is only invited to, or has accepted but is not yet confirmed in, are not listed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--organizations))
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user has two-step login enabled

<a id="nestedatt--users--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.organizations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization
- `name` (String) The name of the organization
- `organization_user_id` (String) The ID of the user's membership in the organization
- `type` (String) The type of the user in the organization: `Owner`, `Admin`, `User` or `Manager`
